author: Unity
description:
Explore the latest 2D tools and performance features arriving in Unity 6.7 and beyond.

Unity 6.7 introduces a full suite of smoothly upgradable 2D graphics tools, Physics Core 2D components that pair a familiar authoring workflow with powerful physics simulation, and comprehensive 2D profiling tools to give you deeper performance insights. See these features in action in our new physics puzzle game sample, built to demonstrate seamless workflow integration and runtime speed.

Looking ahead to Unity 7, we are expanding our RenderSprite APIs to bring even higher performance to 2D rendering across objects like Tilemaps and SpriteShapes.

🔗 Try out Bunny Blitz on the Unity Asset Store: https://on.unity.com/48QR4pr
